ending.ashfall.sever.summary: Cut the Heart loose. The virus sleeps: Antibiotics cure it. Fewer of the dead, horde nights become rare Aftershocks, and every Power Relay charges for free.
ending.ashfall.bind.summary: Take control of the Heart. Resonant Plasma Blades, Overchargers without district gates and bigger Bunker Core havens. The virus keeps evolving: horde nights grow every week up to a limit, and an Ascendant returns every 10 nights.

message.ashfall.aftershock: Aftershock: the Wreck shed more debris. New crash sites lie on the ridge and in the wasteland.

briefing.ashfall.title: ASHFALL
briefing.ashfall.subtitle: Asheville has gone dark
briefing.ashfall.chat.situation: Something crashed on Beaucatcher ridge and pulled the city's power down with it, district by district. The dead walk, and light and noise draw them.
briefing.ashfall.chat.mission: Your mission: relight Asheville. Restore the substations of River Arts, South Slope, Downtown and Mission, then finish the Black Start at the Wreck.
briefing.ashfall.link.read.hover: The whole Mission Briefing. A copy is in your inventory too.
briefing.ashfall.link.objectives.hover: Your checklist and the next step: /ashfall mission
briefing.ashfall.dialog.title: Mission Briefing
briefing.ashfall.page.cover.heading: MISSION BRIEFING
briefing.ashfall.page.cover.body:
For whoever wakes up in the Montford safehouse.

Read it once and keep it. Lost? Type /ashfall mission for your next step, or watch the Objective line by your hotbar.
briefing.ashfall.page.situation.heading: The situation
briefing.ashfall.page.situation.body: Something came down on Beaucatcher ridge. We call it the Wreck. It drank the city's power through the street relays, district by district, until Asheville went dark.
briefing.ashfall.page.the_dead.heading: The dead
briefing.ashfall.page.the_dead.body: Then the dead got up. They hunt by sound and light: shots, doors, running, a lit window at night. Stay quiet and dark and most of them pass you by.
briefing.ashfall.page.mission.heading: Your mission
briefing.ashfall.page.mission.body: Relight Asheville. Four districts are dark: River Arts, South Slope, Downtown and the Mission campus. Restore each one's substation. All four bring the City Grid to %s%%.
briefing.ashfall.page.the_heart.heading: The Wreck
briefing.ashfall.page.the_heart.body: Then climb the ridge for the Black Start: plug the city into the Wreck and live through it. At its centre beats the Heart. You choose its fate: Sever it, or Bind it.
briefing.ashfall.page.repair.heading: 1. Repair
briefing.ashfall.page.repair.body: Find the district's Substation Core. The Field Radio and the Grid Map (key G) point the way. Socket %s Grid Couplers into it. A Coupler is 2 Wire Spools, Scrap Electronics, Weapon Parts and a Battery.
briefing.ashfall.page.energize.heading: 2. Energize
briefing.ashfall.page.energize.body: Load %s full Energy Cells. The core hums for %s minutes; stay within %s blocks or the hold pauses. The hum carries %s blocks, and the dead come to it.
briefing.ashfall.page.link.heading: 3. Link
briefing.ashfall.page.link.body: Touch each of the district's key relays with a Grid Coupler. It is not used up. The hold's boss bar counts the relays still to link.
briefing.ashfall.page.siege.heading: 4. Survive
briefing.ashfall.page.siege.body: At the next nightfall the siren sounds (%s s ahead) and the District Siege hits the core. Keep it standing until the last wave falls, or stay near it until dawn. Lose it and you redo the cells and hold.
briefing.ashfall.page.reclaimed.heading: Reclaimed
briefing.ashfall.page.reclaimed.body: A safe compound round the core, free charging, %s%% less darkness spawning, a reward cache and the lights back on. River Arts makes open water clean inside reclaimed districts; Mission opens Patient Zero's ward.
briefing.ashfall.page.salvage.heading: Getting stronger
briefing.ashfall.page.salvage.body: Salvage everything. Build a Spark Blaster and Small Cell Packs (R reloads). Charge packs at a Field Charger inside a claim, or at a street Power Relay, which hums loud.
briefing.ashfall.page.bench.heading: The Bench
briefing.ashfall.page.bench.body: A Weaponsmith Bench fits attachments: Optic, Dampener, Heat Sink, Cell Regulator, Overcharger. Some wait for a district. A Plasma Blade needs a Resonance Crystal: one of the %s the Uplink takes.
briefing.ashfall.page.bosses.heading: Bosses
briefing.ashfall.page.bosses.body: Each boss drops a Resonance Crystal; you need %s. Crash sites may hold one too. The Abomination: Kiln & Co. Salvage, River Arts. Patient Zero: the Mission hospital, once Mission is lit. The Juggernaut: the Wreck.
briefing.ashfall.page.water.heading: Staying alive
briefing.ashfall.page.water.body: Drink clean. River and pond water is dirty: cook the bottle in a furnace or over a campfire first. Dirty water can infect you.
briefing.ashfall.page.infection.heading: Infection
briefing.ashfall.page.infection.body: A bite can infect. It worsens in four stages, then kills. A Bandage pauses it for a while. Antibiotics push it back a stage, or cure it early.
briefing.ashfall.page.havens.heading: Havens
briefing.ashfall.page.havens.body: The safehouse is a safe zone. A Bunker Core claims a base of your own: no spawns inside, chargers work, you respawn there, and the radio points home.
briefing.ashfall.page.hordes.heading: Hordes
briefing.ashfall.page.hordes.body: A siren at dusk means a horde tonight. Wall up with fortified blocks. Once districts are lit, Breaches hit their cores: hold them, or re-repair a broken one.
briefing.ashfall.page.uplink.heading: The finale
briefing.ashfall.page.uplink.body: At Grid %s%% the Wreck hull opens. Craft the Grid Uplink: an Uplink Frame (lenses, %s crystals, Couplers), two Capacitor Banks, then the Uplink. Seat it in the hull's socket.
briefing.ashfall.page.black_start.body: Surge: feed the Uplink Energy Cells, each buys %s s. Feedback: hold both Relay Breakers for %s s. The Heart: break its four pylons while the Choir fights back.
briefing.ashfall.page.choice.heading: The choice
briefing.ashfall.page.choice.body: When the Heart falls the party votes. Sever: the dead thin out and medicine cures. Bind: Heart power and better gear, but the hordes keep growing. The world carries on either way.
briefing.ashfall.page.lost.heading: If you are lost
briefing.ashfall.page.lost.body: /ashfall mission shows the checklist and how to do the next step. The Objective line by the hotbar points the way. Sneak and use the Field Radio for the way home.

objective.ashfall.radio: Find the Field Radio in the safehouse
objective.ashfall.radio.how: Go upstairs in the Montford safehouse to the radio room and open the cache. Pick up the Field Radio.
objective.ashfall.arm: Craft a Spark Blaster and a Cell Pack
objective.ashfall.arm.how: Spark Blaster: scrap metal, Scrap Electronics, duct tape, an Alloy Plate (smelt Scrap Metal). Small Cell Pack: 3 Wire Spools (loot, or craft from Scrap Electronics) and Scrap Electronics. It comes out empty: charge it at a street Power Relay (loud) or a Field Charger inside a claim such as the safehouse, then press R to load it.
objective.ashfall.district.couplers.how: Right-click the Substation Core with Grid Couplers. Craft them from Wire Spools, Scrap Electronics, Weapon Parts and a Battery. Optional first: a Bunker Core claims a home base.
objective.ashfall.district.rerepair.how: A lost Breach broke this core. Socket the Couplers to put the district straight back on the grid.
objective.ashfall.district.cells.how: Right-click the core with fully charged Energy Cells. The last one starts the hold, so be ready for company.
objective.ashfall.district.hold.how: Stay within %3$s blocks of the core while it hums. Relays linked so far: %4$s/%5$s. Link the rest with a Coupler before or after.
objective.ashfall.district.link.how: Right-click each of the district's key relays with a Grid Coupler. It is not used up. The marker points at the nearest one still dark.
objective.ashfall.district.siege_soon.ho: Be at the core when the siren sounds. Wall up the control room, bring cells and spare packs.
objective.ashfall.district.siege.how: Keep the core standing until the last wave falls, or stay near it until dawn.
objective.ashfall.district.reclaimed.how: The district is back on the grid.
objective.ashfall.crystals.how: Each story boss drops one: the Abomination at Kiln & Co. Salvage, Patient Zero under the Mission hospital, the Juggernaut at the Wreck. Crash sites may hold one too.
objective.ashfall.crystals.crash: Collect Resonance Crystals %s/%s from crash sites
objective.ashfall.crystals.crash.how: Every story boss is down. Crash-site chests sometimes hold a crystal; search each one. A Plasma Blade spends a crystal the Uplink needs.
objective.ashfall.uplink.how: Uplink Frame: Focusing Lenses, Resonance Crystals, Couplers. Capacitor Bank: Energy Cells round a Coupler. Then the Uplink: frame, banks, Couplers. REI shows each recipe.
objective.ashfall.black_start.go: Seat the Grid Uplink in the Wreck hull
objective.ashfall.black_start.go.how: The hull opens once all four districts are lit; the city is at %s%%. Bring cells, Couplers and a charged Plasma Blade, then use the Uplink on the socket.
objective.ashfall.black_start.standby: Restart the Black Start at the hull socket
objective.ashfall.black_start.standby.ho: The spent Uplink waits in its socket. Use the socket with an empty hand to start a new Surge.
objective.ashfall.black_start.surge: Black Start: keep the Uplink fed
objective.ashfall.black_start.surge.how: Feed it full Energy Cells to keep the buffer from running dry, and patch it with Couplers.
objective.ashfall.black_start.feedback: Black Start: hold both Relay Breakers
objective.ashfall.black_start.feedback.h: Stand by each breaker until it closes. Keep patching the Uplink; specials pour from the vents.
objective.ashfall.black_start.heart: Black Start: break the Heart pylons %s/%s
objective.ashfall.black_start.heart.how: A lit Plasma Blade cuts a pylon fast. Keep the Choir busy while someone works.
objective.ashfall.black_start.paused: Black Start paused: patch or feed the Uplink
objective.ashfall.black_start.paused.how: Patch it with Couplers to half health and feed it a cell to resume. Finished phases and broken pylons stay, but a Surge loses about a minute and the breakers must be held again.
objective.ashfall.choose: Choose the Heart's fate: Sever or Bind
objective.ashfall.choose.how: The players at the Heart vote: click [Sever] or [Bind] in chat. Hover them to see what each does.
objective.ashfall.choose.waiting: The Heart has fallen: its fate waits
objective.ashfall.choose.waiting.how: No vote is open. A player who fought at the Heart reopens it by rejoining; with the story objective off, an op picks with /ashfall ending set.
objective.ashfall.after: Asheville is relit (%s). Hold what you built
objective.ashfall.after.how: Breaches still hit lit substations, bosses return, and aftershocks bring new crash sites. Missed Relay Logs fill your epilogue.
objective.ashfall.after.breach.how: Keep the core standing until dawn, or the district goes broken.

message.ashfall.grid.relay_not_linked: This relay isn't linked to %s. Link it with a Grid Coupler first
objective.ashfall.district.blackout: %s has blacked out: repair its relays
objective.ashfall.district.blackout.how: Worn relays cut the power. Use a Wire Spool on each linked relay, with Duct Tape in your pack, until enough work again.
radio.ashfall.decay.flicker: %s flickering: %s/%s relays working, blackout in %s days
tooltip.ashfall.arc_charge: Stuns nearby zombies for 3 s. Loud.
tooltip.ashfall.nail_launcher: Fires Nails from your inventory. Weak, but zombies barely hear it
tooltip.ashfall.crowbar: Hold use on a locked Strongbox for %s s to force it. Zombies within %s blocks hear it give
radio_job.ashfall.offer.stash: Supplies left in a %s in %s, %s m %s.
radio_job.ashfall.offer.nest: Zombies holed up in a %s in %s, %s m %s. Clear them out for what they're sitting on.
radio_job.ashfall.offer.distress: Someone calling from the top floor of a %s in %s, %s m %s.
message.ashfall.radio_job.calls: The shortwave picked up %s call(s). Use a Shortwave Set to listen.
message.ashfall.radio_job.static: Only static. New calls come in each morning.
message.ashfall.radio_job.accepted: %s answered a call: %s You have one day.
message.ashfall.radio_job.busy: You're already answering a call. Finish it first.
message.ashfall.radio_job.nest_cleared: The nest is cleared. What they were guarding is on the ground floor.
message.ashfall.radio_job.distress_answe: The caller slipped out while you held them off. They left you the crate.
message.ashfall.radio_job.done.stash: Radio job done: the supplies are yours.
message.ashfall.radio_job.done.nest: Radio job done: the nest is gone.
message.ashfall.radio_job.done.distress: Radio job done: the caller got away.
message.ashfall.radio_job.lost: The radio call went quiet. The job is lost.
message.ashfall.supply_locker.bunker_onl: A Supply Locker only goes inside a Bunker Core's area.
message.ashfall.survivor.greet.stranger: You're not one of them. Thank God. Can you get me somewhere safe?
message.ashfall.survivor.greet.stay: I'm holding here until you say otherwise.
message.ashfall.survivor.greet.home: Good to have walls again. What do you need?
message.ashfall.survivor.no_home: I haven't got a home to go back to. Take me to yours.
message.ashfall.survivor.settled_note: %s has settled in at your bunker.
message.ashfall.survivor.gone: That survivor isn't here any more.
message.ashfall.survivor.too_far: Get closer to %s to give orders.
message.ashfall.survivor.role.settler: Fine by me. I'll keep my head down and stay out of their way.
message.ashfall.survivor.role.guard: I'll keep them off us. Hand me something to swing (sneak and use it on me).
message.ashfall.survivor.role.not_yet: I don't know how to do that yet.
message.ashfall.survivor.weapon.thanks: That'll do. They won't get past me.
message.ashfall.survivor.weapon.blaster: I never learned to shoot one of those. Give me something to swing.
message.ashfall.survivor.weapon.plasma_b: That blade needs someone who can keep it charged. Give me something simpler to swing.
message.ashfall.survivor.weapon.stored: (The weapon went into the Supply Locker.)
message.ashfall.survivor.weapon.dropped: (No Supply Locker with room, so the weapon is on the floor.)
message.ashfall.survivor.hover.follow: Walk behind you. Inside your Bunker Core's area, tell them [Stay] or [Settle here] to make it home.
message.ashfall.survivor.hover.home: Go back to the bunker and live there.
message.ashfall.survivor.hover.role.sett: Settler: no job. Lives at the base and runs from zombies. A guard's weapon goes back to the Supply Locker.
message.ashfall.survivor.hover.role.guar: Guard: fights zombies within 16 blocks with the weapon you hand it (sneak and use the weapon on them).
message.ashfall.survivor.greet.bitten: It bit me. I don't feel right. If you've got antibiotics, now's the time.
message.ashfall.survivor.hover.settle: Make this bunker home: live here and wander inside its area.
message.ashfall.survivor.settle.not_here: This isn't your place. Take me to your own bunker.
message.ashfall.survivor.settle.full: There's no room. You've already got %s of us here.
message.ashfall.survivor.rescued: You heard me. I'll go where you go. Just get me out of here.
message.ashfall.survivor.rescue_full: You can't take in anyone else (%s survivors at most), so the caller slips away on their own.
message.ashfall.survivor.rescue_world_fu: The world already has %s survivors, so the caller slips away on their own.
message.ashfall.survivor.holdout.call: Hey! Over here! Please, I've been hiding up here for days!
message.ashfall.survivor.holdout.full: You've already got %s people to look after. I'll take my chances up here.
message.ashfall.survivor.holdout.world_f: There are already %s of us out there with someone. I'll take my chances up here.
message.ashfall.survivor.bitten_note: %s has been bitten. Antibiotics within a day, or they turn.
message.ashfall.survivor.treat.cured: That's better. Thank you. I thought I was done for.
message.ashfall.survivor.treat.healthy: I'm not bitten. Keep those for when it counts.
message.ashfall.survivor.role.scavenger: I know these streets. One trip a day, in the morning, if there's food in the lockers for the road.
message.ashfall.survivor.role.medic: Keep bandages and antibiotics in the Supply Lockers and I'll patch up our people near the bunker.
message.ashfall.survivor.role.mechanic: Leave scrap metal, duct tape and wire spools in the lockers and I'll keep the strips and relays working.
message.ashfall.survivor.role.away: (They're out scavenging. It'll have to wait until they're back.)
message.ashfall.survivor.role.needs_home: I can only do that from a base with Supply Lockers. Settle me in first.
message.ashfall.survivor.hover.role.scav: Scavenger: once a day, in the morning, takes 1 food from a Supply Locker and goes out for half a day. Brings back about half a building room into the lockers. Sometimes comes back hurt, rarely not at all.
message.ashfall.survivor.hover.role.medi: Medic: within 16 blocks of the bunker, for its own group only, cures bitten survivors with Antibiotics, slows a player's infection once a day and bandages the hurt, all from the Supply Lockers.
message.ashfall.survivor.hover.role.mech: Mechanic: every 30 seconds fixes one worn Spike Strip in the claim (1 Scrap Metal) or one worn relay in the claim or district (1 Wire Spool and 1 Duct Tape), from the Supply Lockers.
message.ashfall.survivor.scavenger_lost: %s went out scavenging and never came back.
message.ashfall.survivor.medic.nursed: Sit still. This'll keep it from spreading for a while. Come back tomorrow.
message.ashfall.survivor.status.carrying: The lockers are full. I'm holding on to what I found until there's room.
message.ashfall.survivor.status.not_home: I can only work from home. Send me back to the bunker.
message.ashfall.survivor.status.scavenge: I've been out today. Tomorrow morning.
I'll head out in the morning, if there's food for the road.
I'm not going anywhere like this. Patch me up first.
The lockers are full. I'm holding on to what I found until there's room.
There's no food in the lockers. I'm not going out there hungry.
message.ashfall.survivor.status.medic.em: Out of bandages and antibiotics. I can't treat anyone.
message.ashfall.survivor.status.medic.no: Out of bandages. I've got %s antibiotics for bites, nothing for wounds.
message.ashfall.survivor.status.mechanic: Nothing to fix with: I need scrap metal, or a wire spool and duct tape.
I've got %s scrap metal, %s wire spools and %s duct tape.
message.ashfall.survivor.hungry: I haven't eaten in %s day(s). Put some food in the Supply Lockers or I can't keep this up.
message.ashfall.survivor.hungry_away: I haven't eaten in %s day(s). Keep some food on you or I can't keep this up.
message.ashfall.survivor.new_role: (Still learning the job. Give me a day.)
message.ashfall.survivor.left_hungry: %s went %s days without food and left the bunker for good.
message.ashfall.survivor.left_hungry_awa: %s went %s days without food and left you for good.
message.ashfall.survivor.trader.no_order: I don't take orders. I keep this stall, and that's all.
message.ashfall.survivor.trader.busy: One at a time. I'm dealing with %s.
message.ashfall.survivor.trader.empty: Nothing to sell right now. Come back in a few days.
message.ashfall.survivor.trader.sold_out: I'm sold out. Come back in %s day(s).
tooltip.ashfall.flamethrower: Hold to spray fire: burns every zombie in a short cone. Never sets blocks alight
tooltip.ashfall.flamethrower.refuel: Press %s to pour in Lighter Fluid
death.attack.ashfall.flamethrower: %1$s was burnt to a crisp by %2$s
death.attack.ashfall.flamethrower.item: %1$s was burnt to a crisp by %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.ashfall.flamethrower.player: %1$s was burnt to a crisp while fighting %2$s
